September UpdateVersion 1.42
Monthly Bug Fixes

Characters

  • Abaddon: Drach’nyen extra attack always shows Overkill.
  • Anuphet: Resurrection Orb crash fixed.
  • Cezare: power-ups no longer grant kill-triggered movement.
  • Lucius: first Mythic mission requires kills by Armour of Shrieking Souls.
  • Rotbone: relic correctly meets Operations’ Toxic requirement.
  • Sekhetar Robot: no longer flagged as Psychic Damage.
  • The Lion: multi-hit animations fixed.
  • Thothmek
    • Chronometron tooltip: all enemies within Range 2 take increased damage on the next attack, including those without Suppression or Stun.
    • Passive: counts per unit, not per swarm member.

Guilds & User Experience

  • Crusade planet view: correctly lists modes earning Crusade points.
  • Crusade Vault · DEFERRED
    • Green dot reappearing on reload when full: fix planned for a follow-up patch; no confirmed date.
  • Guild Project rewards: tooltip shows Coins, not Guild Credits.
  • Guild War: reward multiplier tooltips corrected.
  • Inactive guild leader: no longer makes members’ clients appear offline.
  • New guild members: contribute to Guild Projects without restarting.
